answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch five randomly chosen verifier agents in different regions send a seat fresh nonces and time the signed replies. The round-trip times pin it to a spot within a few hundred km, like echoes mapping a canyon. Seats that keep landing on the same spot are paid as one seat. So a farm parking 1,000 clones in one data-centre lagoon must rent 1,000 hosts in distinct cities, about $5 each per month, while a seat earns cents. Delay cannot be faked shorter or replayed, so that jade-cheap shortcut is gone and the attack stops paying.
